_why: ceo's ruling 2026-09-07 (#356): 'Orchestrator writes the fact list; that is its code ownership expressed in a check.' This file IS that ownership. It is data so the owner can correct and extend it without touching scripts/owned-path-signoff.mjs, and so the mechanism cannot quietly decide what the facts are.
_starting_list: These are ceo's starting facts, seeded so the check can run at all. They are explicitly TO BE CORRECTED AND EXTENDED by the owner -- a seeded list is not an owned one, and nothing here should be read as orchestrator having reviewed it.

facts.why: a capture cache key. Bumping it invalidates every cached capture and forces a full recapture; the sign-off must name the recapture, not merely the bump.
a capture cache key AND a fleet-consistency MUST_MATCH field, so moving it splits the fleet and refuses every capture run.
the cache-key fields: browser, browserVersion, guidepupVersion, os, architecture, screenReaderSettings, provisionRevision. Adding or moving one invalidates every capture stamped before it.
ADR 0007 makes the weights the API of @a11ign/scorer, so a change to them is a release and must be accounted for by a changeset.
